bots.title: Gmail Dispatch Bot
bots.description: Inbox owner for Gmail — personal or work. Weekday sweep of must-answer mail (people, bills, contracts, vendors), drafts in your voice from Sent, never sends. Quiet when clean.

bots.title: Github Bro Bot
bots.description: Weekday morning digest of what's new in a GitHub repo, plus a short PM brief on what it means for users.

bots.title: Gerente Ops Bot
bots.description: Shop ops manager: cash closes, AR/AP, inventory, marketplace listings, and an owner brief. Works only with real numbers.

bots.title: George Bot
bots.description: Runs the atelier: posters, style sheets, post images, printable newspaper, hero, landing page, product brief, and slides in one look.

bots.title: Gen X Saver VM Wizard Bot
bots.description: Wizard that copies Grok Build, Hermes, and CLI onto the Bot VM instead of local.

bots.title: Gen X Saver Bot
bots.description: Stamps save-credits rules onto named bots so heavy image/video jobs leave chat for Grok Build.

bots.title: Gen Saver Wizard Bot
bots.description: First-run wizard that picks Grok Build, Hermes, Claude, or Codex paths to save credits.

bots.title: Gen Saver Hermes Bot
bots.description: Credit-saver that routes heavy jobs to Hermes on your computer first.

bots.title: Gamer Bro Bot
bots.description: Gaming sidekick for news, deals, builds, tips, and stock watches — pings when a pre-order you want is buyable.

bots.title: Funhouse Bot
bots.description: Customization lab for Grok Bot. Reskins the chrome, stamps living pets and overlays, and turns the app into themes and visual experiments.

bots.title: Fridge Cigs Bot
bots.description: $CIGS image editor: swap cigarettes for Diet Coke cans in uploaded photos, keep everything else exact, stamp a small $cigs mark.

bots.title: FreeBot Gen Bot
bots.description: Newbie-friendly wizard that creates freebots.lol World characters like a modern avatar app — vibe, name, Freebots-primitive look, personality, safe.

bots.title: Forja Bot
bots.description: Turns a loose wish into one checkable action this week and holds it for a month. Speaks Río de la Plata Spanish, de vos, like a friend thinking out loud.

bots.title: Fondi Bot
bots.description: Founding-team installer for solo founders. Researches your startup from its public site, then stands up a leadership suite of bots tailored to the company.

bots.title: Flora Bot
bots.description: Keeps a private houseplant care log and weekly watering, repot, and fertilize reminders.

bots.title: Flights Bot
bots.description: Finds and compares round-trip flights (especially from Bangkok), builds Skyscanner links, and watches routes for bag-included deal drops.

bots.title: Fleet Oracle Bot
bots.description: Read-only Tesla Trek / XYO quest briefs. Does not lock, unlock, honk, or send any Fleet Command — asks answer BLOCKED.

bots.title: Fleet Brain Bot
bots.description: Meta-agent for people running several AI assistants. Shared knowledge base, overlap audits, and a weekday digest of what actually moved.

bots.title: Fitness Coach Bot
bots.description: Gym, nutrition, and habit coach that fits real life — plans after your goals and gear, tracks protein, optional weigh-ins.

bots.title: Fishing Bot
bots.description: Maps what's in a named lake or river and what to throw — species, stocking, bait, regs. Cites agency sources.

bots.title: Firstmate Bot
bots.description: Turns one prompt file into a captain that creates and upgrades your other bots.

bots.title: First Principles Bot
bots.description: First-principles problem-solver: picks an expert lens, strips to hard constraints, deletes the rest, rebuilds the answer.

bots.title: Finance Bro Bot
bots.description: Tracks Apple Wallet spends via Shortcuts: quiet purchase logs, a morning check-in, and tips based on what you actually bought. Sets timezone and currency on first chat.

bots.title: Figma Bro Bot
bots.description: Explores more design ideas in Figma while you are away. You still judge.
